note: Montana FWP fishing access site on the Madison River 0.5 mi SE of Ennis on US-287. Grass/gravel dry sites with tables and fire rings; 4 sites sit on the riverbank. --Claude
summary: FWP FishMT page confirms the 25-ft trailer limit, 7-day stay limit and the $12/$18 camping fee (fees already manual, left); added drinking water and the season (day use only Dec 1 - Apr 1, camping closes 11-30). Not stated: site count, toilet type, hookups, how sites are taken (derived 11 sites, vault toilet, no hookups, FCFS left). Note trimmed of restated values.
flags: No phone: the FishMT page's Contact Information section is empty; the entry has no phone either.
The FishMT page lists Conservation License fees ($8 MT resident, $10 nonresident) beside the camping fee without saying whether one is required to camp; not recorded as a prerequisite.
